name: Commerce & Storefront

designIntent.primaryGoal: Make product discovery, comparison and purchase decisions clear and trustworthy.
designIntent.visualThesis: Product imagery and information carry the page; interface chrome supports the decision.

visualDirection.density: low-to-medium on product storytelling; higher for catalog comparison and filters
visualDirection.surfaces: simple product surfaces; separate promotional content from purchase-critical information
visualDirection.colorIntent: brand-led accent with distinct sale, stock and validation states
visualDirection.typography: expressive display type may support brand, but price, size and shipping remain highly legible
visualDirection.motion: subtle gallery and cart feedback; never delay purchase controls

layout.pattern: category navigation + filters + product grid; product details use media and decision column
layout.spacing: generous around product imagery; compact and aligned for specification tables
layout.responsive: mobile filters and purchase CTA remain reachable without hiding critical terms

accessibility.keyboard: filters, galleries, variants and checkout must support keyboard use
accessibility.focus: variant selection and cart updates need visible state and announced feedback
accessibility.reducedMotion: product carousel and cart animation must not be required to understand state

antiPatterns: product images without meaningful alt text
notes: Never invent product reviews, customer counts, certifications or delivery promises.

aiGuidance.primaryFlow: Discover category → narrow options → inspect product → compare terms → choose variant → checkout → confirmation.
prioritize: Accurate product image, name and distinguishing attributes
Price, stock, delivery, returns and payment terms
Variant selection and purchase action without hidden conditions
confirmOrMarkUnknown: Real prices, taxes, currency, availability and shipping rules
Reviews, certifications, scarcity and customer claims before display
avoidByDefault: Fake stock urgency, countdowns or testimonials
Generic feature cards in place of product discovery
acceptanceChecks: Filters and selections behave as labelled
Costs and important terms appear before commitment

compositionEscapes.when: The key task is browsing a broad catalogue and narrowing many products.
compositionEscapes.composition: Lead with category context and useful filters; choose a grid or compact list based on image importance and attribute complexity.
contentRequirements: Real product records and meaningful filters
avoid: Filters that do not affect results

compositionEscapes.when: The page is about understanding one product and deciding whether it fits.
compositionEscapes.composition: Make product media and decision-critical details primary; keep variant, price, delivery and purchase controls near the decision point.
contentRequirements: Price and availability with source or freshness
Shipping, return or warranty terms where applicable
avoid: Hidden fees or speculative delivery promises

compositionEscapes.when: Users must compare a small number of alternatives with materially different specifications or terms.
compositionEscapes.composition: Use a comparison table or aligned attribute groups with an obvious path to inspect each product in detail.
contentRequirements: Accessible table headers and narrow-screen alternative
